verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਲੈ ਧਰਮ ਵੀਚਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹਿਠਾ।
verses.translit_en: sooraj ghar avataar lai dharam veechaaran jai bahiThaa|

en.bdb: Born in the family of Sun, he (Dharrnaraj) adorned the seat of the dispenser of justice.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਤਿ ਇਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਦੁਇ ਧਰਮਰਾਇ ਜਮ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਰਿਠਾ।
verses.translit_en: moorat ikaa naau dhui dharamarai jam dhekh sariThaa|

en.bdb: He is one but the creation knows him by two names-Dharmaraj and Yama.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੀ ਡਿਠਾ ਧਰਮਰਾਇ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਮ ਡਿਠਾ।
verses.translit_en: dharamee ddiThaa dharamarai paap kamai paapee jam ddiThaa|

en.bdb: People see him pious and righteous in the form of Dharmaraj but the wicked sinner as Yama.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਨੋ ਪਛੜਾਇੰਦਾ ਧਰਮੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਬੁਲੇਂਦਾ ਮਿਠਾ।
verses.translit_en: paapee no pachhaRai(n)dhaa dharamee naal bule(n)dhaa miThaa|

en.bdb: He also thrashes the evil doer but speks sweetly to the religious person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੈਰੀ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਵੈਰ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਇਠਾ।
verses.translit_en: vairee dhekhan vair bhai mitr bhai kar dhekhan iThaa|

en.bdb: Enemy sees him with enmity and the friendly people know him as loving one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਵਰ ਸਰਾਪ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਅਭਰਿਠਾ।
verses.translit_en: narak surag vich pu(n)n paap var saraap jaanan abhariThaa|

en.bdb: Sin and merit, boon and curse, heaven and hell are known and realised according to one's own feelings (of love and enmity).
Mirror reflects the shadow according to the object before it.
